subject: Finishes that help a workspace feel calm
hook: Choose your finish at 4pm, not in a showroom
ig:
Choose your finish at 4pm, not in a showroom.

This is a typical route for a home office where the brief is simply 'make it feel calm':

Samples come to your house and sit on the wall where the desk will go. You look at them in daylight, then again with the lamp on in the evening, because that's when you'll often be working.

We then show the layout in 3D with your finish and handle choice, including where the screen sits relative to the window. That's when glare problems get caught.

After that, it's workshop time: panels cut, edges matched, carcasses assembled and checked. Our own team installs and adjusts everything.

Swipe through the stages. If you're about to choose finishes for a workspace, share this with whoever you're deciding with.
fb:
Here's a tip we give anyone choosing finishes for a home office: decide at home, at the time of day you'll actually be working.

We bring samples to you, and we'd encourage you to look at them in daylight and again with your evening lamp on. Matt finishes tend to stay calm in both; glossier finishes can pick up the window. Then we show the layout in 3D, build it in our Hanley workshop and fit it with our own team.

The carousel walks through a typical route from sample to finished room. Have a look at home office options here:

on_asset: F1: Samples at home — Finish samples go on your actual desk wall. A colour that looks soft in a bright showroom can look flat or cold in a north-facing spare room. | F2: Check at two times — Look in daylight and again with your evening lamp on. Matt finishes change least; gloss can mirror a window. | F3: 3D review — We show the layout with your chosen finish, handle style and where the screen will sit, so glare points are spotted early. | F4: Cut and edged — Panels are cut on the panel saw and edged in a matching colour in our Hanley workshop. | F5: Assembled and checked — Carcasses are built and quality-checked before they leave. | F6: Installed — Our own team fits it, adjusts doors and leaves the room ready to work in.
